stages.name: Tide Pool
stages.blurb: The King needs a small sticky star. Roll the shallows.
stages.kingIntro: Small work for a small Prince. Do not be offended. Be useful.
kingPraise: Hmm! Sticky, round, and faintly fishy. Perfect. Hang it in the sky!
A petite little blob. Not royal, exactly, but charming in a damp way.
Yes, yes. The shallows are less embarrassing now.
kingFailure: Tiny! Minuscule! We have seen plankton with greater ambition.
The Cosmos cannot hang a shrug in the sky. Roll larger.
A damp marble is not a star, little Prince.

stages.name: Coral Reef
stages.blurb: Bigger waters. Bigger ambitions. Make a proper reef-star.
stages.kingIntro: Now the reef. Colorful, crowded, and terribly under-rolled.
kingPraise: Magnificent lump! The cosmos looks slightly more... moist. I approve.
Ah! A reef-star. Gaudy, sticky, almost fashionable.
The corals tremble. The King nods. This is progress.
kingFailure: A reef requires volume, not optimism.
You rolled with feeling, but not enough circumference.
Pretty colors, little result. The King sighs beautifully.

stages.name: Harbor
stages.blurb: Roll the docks. Leave no buoy un-scooped.
stages.kingIntro: The harbor is cluttered with mortal nonsense. Convert it to astronomy.
kingPraise: A lighthouse of junk! Truly, my child, you understand stickiness.
Splendid! We can smell the dock from here. Very celestial.
Boats, buoys, barnacles of destiny. Into the sky with it!
kingFailure: No beacon today. Merely a floating disappointment.
The King expected grandeur. The Prince delivered a beach toy.
